pages.title: Private iPhone Location History & Route Journal — Whereday
pages.metaDescription: Whereday is a private location journal for iPhone and Apple Watch. Automatically record visits and routes on-device, with no account, no Whereday location servers, and optional export in eight formats when you need your history.

pages.title: About Whereday — Private iPhone Location Journal
pages.metaDescription: Meet Whereday, the open source iPhone and Apple Watch location journal built by Cody Bontecou at isolated.tech.

pages.title: iPhone Location History Guides — Whereday
pages.metaDescription: Practical iPhone location history guides: record a private journal, compare Google Timeline, choose export formats, and understand tracking controls.

pages.title: Back Up and Restore iPhone Location History — Whereday
pages.metaDescription: Back up Whereday visits and GPS points as JSON. See checked file-picker imports, saved counts after an app restart, and limits to verify before changing iPhones.

pages.title: Export an iPhone Location Journal to Obsidian — Whereday
pages.metaDescription: Export Whereday visits as Markdown for Obsidian. Includes checked desktop notes and Maps plugin examples, synthetic downloads, and timezone and sync limits.

pages.title: iPhone GPS Tracking and Battery Use: Whereday Settings
pages.metaDescription: Check iPhone battery activity, choose Whereday distance filters and auto-stop settings, and compare route detail without assuming a guaranteed battery saving.

pages.title: Missing Visits or GPS Points in Whereday? iPhone Checks
pages.metaDescription: Check an empty Whereday outing, missing GPS points, visits, Watch sync, or export filters. Includes a checked zero-point example and steps that preserve your journal.

pages.title: How to Keep a Private Location Journal on iPhone — Whereday
pages.metaDescription: Record a private iPhone location journal, check saved GPS points and visits, and keep portable copies of your on-device history.

pages.title: How to Record an iPhone Route and Export GPX — Whereday
pages.metaDescription: Record a route in Whereday and export GPX to Files. Includes a checked export-and-viewer example with synthetic points, previews, and free and paid limits.

pages.title: Track Days Spent in Each Country on iPhone — Whereday
pages.metaDescription: Track country dates from visits, GPS points, and manual stays in Whereday. Inspect a checked CSV example for travel days, timezones, overlaps, and gaps.

pages.title: How to See Your Location History on iPhone — Whereday
pages.metaDescription: Find iPhone location history in Apple Maps or Google Timeline, check Significant Locations settings, and preserve existing records before changing devices.

pages.title: Compare iPhone Location Journals — Whereday
pages.metaDescription: Compare Whereday with Google Timeline on iPhone: accounts, recording, backups, exports, and the limits of moving an existing archive.

pages.title: Google Timeline Alternative for iPhone: Whereday Compared
pages.metaDescription: Compare Whereday and Google Timeline for iPhone: accounts, local history, encrypted backup, GPX and CSV exports, pricing, and import limitations.

pages.title: Contact Whereday — Support and Project Links
pages.metaDescription: Contact Whereday developer Cody Bontecou for support, bug reports, and questions about the private iPhone location journal.

pages.title: Documentation — Whereday Docs
pages.metaDescription: Practical guides for every corner of Whereday: tracking, timelines, exports, automation, the Apple Watch app, and privacy.

pages.title: Record Apple Watch GPS routes without your iPhone — Whereday Docs
pages.metaDescription: Record on Apple Watch, check transfer status, and verify the phone copy with a checked offline-queue example.

pages.title: Automatically export iPhone location history to a folder — Whereday Docs
pages.metaDescription: Set up daily or interval exports, check rewrite and append behavior, and verify saved files in Whereday.

pages.title: Export and restore location history — Whereday Docs
pages.metaDescription: Eight export formats, filters, filename templates, and free import for restores.

pages.title: Getting started — Whereday Docs
pages.metaDescription: Install, onboarding, permissions, and your first tracking session.

pages.title: Photos on the map — Whereday Docs
pages.metaDescription: Optionally connect your Photos library to place pictures on your map and outings.

pages.title: Save and edit places in your iPhone location journal — Whereday Docs
pages.metaDescription: Manage saved locations, enter coordinates, import a places CSV, and distinguish reusable places from past visits in Whereday.

pages.title: Privacy & your data — Whereday Docs
pages.metaDescription: What stays on your device, what can leave it, and how deletion works.

pages.title: Siri & Shortcuts for iPhone location tracking — Whereday Docs
pages.metaDescription: Start and stop tracking, read saved visits, rename outings, and export a chosen date range with Whereday Shortcuts actions.

pages.title: Timeline & outings — Whereday Docs
pages.metaDescription: The daily timeline, inferred outings, route replay, and editing or deleting sessions.

pages.title: Visits, routes & battery — Whereday Docs
pages.metaDescription: How automatic visit detection and route recording work, and the settings that control them.

pages.title: Webhooks & self-hosting — Whereday Docs
pages.metaDescription: Configure optional delivery and verify your receiver’s payload and authentication requirements.

pages.title: Use Your Whereday Location History in Other Tools
pages.metaDescription: Choose a checked workflow for Whereday records: Markdown notes in Obsidian or optional Overland webhook batches to a Dawarich receiver.

pages.title: Send Whereday iPhone Location Points to Dawarich with Overland
pages.metaDescription: Configure Whereday’s Overland webhook for Dawarich, check authentication and saved points, and understand why Test Connection does not prove storage.

pages.title: Privacy Policy — Whereday
pages.metaDescription: Whereday privacy policy: location history is stored on-device with no account and no server-side location archive. Optional Apple services, first-party onboarding analytics, user-configured webhooks, and export-scheduling metadata are disclosed in full.

pages.title: Terms of Service — Whereday
pages.metaDescription: Terms for Whereday, a private iPhone location journal with local storage, free tracking, and optional export unlock.

pages.title: Whereday：iPhone 私密位置日记与路线记录
pages.metaDescription: 使用 Whereday 在 iPhone 上记录到访地点和行走路线，查看自己的位置时间线。无需账户，位置日记保存在设备上，支持 Apple Watch 和可选的多格式导出。
